<thought>The monoisotopic mass from the base peak is 179.0946 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass is C₁₀H₁₃NO₂ (120 + 13.1017 + 14.0031 + 31.9898 = 179.0946 Da). The isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1) is consistent with ~10 carbons (10 × 1.1 % ≈ 11 %).</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13NO2</final_answer>
